page.overview:
What is Angel Guard?

The Angel Guard is a Codex Astartes-compliant Loyalist Space Marine Chapter of unknown Founding and genetic origin.

The Angel Guard Chapter wears emerald-green power armour. The Aquila or Imperialis on the chest is silver.

The white squad tactical specialty symbol -- battleline, close support, fire support, Veteran or command -- is indicated on the right shoulder plate.

A red High Gothic numeral centred in the middle of the squad specialty symbol indicates squad number.
